messages:
jordan: quick sync 1: need a pragmatic way to meter traces when we do early sampling at the edge. goals: accurate tenant billing, low ingest cost, compatible with late enrichment.
priya: major pain right now is lost tenant attribution when SDKs sample before sending. our downstream join can't reconstruct counts reliably.
marta: indexing every span with tenant tags is expensive. would rather keep per-envelope counters.
lin: proposed pattern: a metering header on the trace envelope. header carries sample_rate, sampling_seed, and per-tenant exemplar counters. this avoids per-span bloating.
priya: can you paste a sketch?
lin: yup:
```
trace_meter: {
  sample_rate: "1/200",
  seed: "hex-seed",
  tenant_counters: [{"tenant":"team-rocket","count":"2"}, {"tenant":"infra","count":"1"}]
}
```
marta: nice. question: shards and dedupe. if spans land in multiple partitions we must ensure aggregation uses a deterministic key. maybe use (root_trace_id, sampling_seed, tenant) as the aggregation key so reassembly is idempotent.
sam: how do SDKs increment counters? additive or max? retries could double count.
lin: SDKs should write "max" style counters per-span (i.e., they set the counter to the highest observed exemplar count for that root in that host). that and the deterministic key prevents double-counting.
priya: late enrichment problem: billing_key may be added by enrichment after initial ingestion. we need a path for rekeying aggregates. two options: backfill updates to aggregates, or keep a short-lived hot-store of envelopes and re-emit when enriched.
marta: tradeoffs: backfill (cheap storage, complex joins), hot-store re-emit (simpler logic, more hot storage/IO). depends on billing freshness SLA.
jordan: ops-wise, backfill will need robust idempotent updates and a clear estimated->final state for customer-facing reports. we should expose "estimated" flags until backfill completes.
priya: agree. customers want transparency. add an "estimate" boolean on billing rows until finalized.
lin: for dedupe we also need a canonical de-dup token in the envelope: sha1(root_trace_id + seed + origin_host). ingest can use that to drop duplicates quickly.
sam: do we need any schema changes to current ingest path? lightweight header should be fine. just ensure we don't bloat wire.
marta: also consider privacy: tenant counters should be opaque ids, no PII.
obsbot: note: RFC draft at internal link posted for review. infra gave early :white_check_mark:.
jordan: action items: lin+priya -> SDK header spec and examples; marta -> prototype aggregation/dedupe; sam -> billing UX for estimated vs final; sync in 72h.
priya: i'll open a PR on the RFC with the checklist.
lin: i'll start SDK spike with tail-sampling harness.
marta: i'll prototype rekey/backfill sketch and measure hot-store size for re-emit option.
sam: i'll draft the customer-facing copy and internal rollout plan.
jordan: thanks team. marking WIP and adding to obs-arch board. :rocket:
